brief:
A young skateboarder in Gaza navigates damaged rooftops as the territory's conflict enters its fourth year, The Guardian reported. The skater describes practicing his sport on structures destroyed during fighting, one of five Palestinians whose daily routines the outlet documented to illustrate the war's human cost.

The series follows ordinary residents through their days, each accounting testifying to the toll the prolonged conflict has taken on Palestinian life. Their stories reveal how civilians adapt and persist in carrying out routine activities within a landscape marked by destruction.
dek: As the war in Gaza approaches its fourth year, the Guardian follows five ordinary Palestinians as they go about their lives. Each tells the story of their day, revealing the terrible toll of the conflict.
title: Skateboarder in Gaza pursues sport amid war's wreckage
